messages.body: stoprule plan: the new command spec-panel-stoprule.md is to be a full copy of the current spec-panel.md. That file ends with a 12-line '## Unattended mode' section. tests/skills/test_worker_contract.py requires the set of commands having that section to be exactly its 31 listed commands (test_unattended_sections_match_the_listed_commands, plus count asserts of 31 and 15 at lines 1557-1564), so a verbatim copy fails it. Option A (recommended): copy everything except the '## Unattended mode' section; the variant then runs only in person mode or without --unattended, which matches the S1 arms (they used the 472-line file that has no such section), and no worker-contract test or WORKER-CONTRACT.md text changes. Option B: keep the section verbatim and extend test_worker_contract.py (new entry, counts 31->32, set checks) so the variant also accepts --unattended --report-dir. Which?
